title: Accounts
notes: DECIDED (owner, 2026-08-07): KEEP /accounts as an explicit, honestly-labelled VIEW OF SUPPLIERS. Do NOT invent an accounts backend, do NOT create an Account model, and do NOT delete the route. Requirements: (1) the page must state plainly in the UI that it is a filtered view of Suppliers — no pretending to be a separate entity; (2) it reads through suppliersApi only; (3) row actions and the detail drawer navigate into the Suppliers detail route rather than a fake /accounts/:id; (4) the sidebar label should read as a Suppliers view, e.g. nested under Suppliers; (5) it still meets the full list-page UX contract (FilterBar, infinite scroll, hover actions, skeleton, empty state, themed export).
showcaseScript: Open Accounts from the sidebar and note it is a Suppliers view
Filter by category to narrow the corporate accounts
Open a row and land on the full Supplier detail
